# Accordion

> An animated accordion for React and shadcn, built on Base UI Accordion.

- Docs and live demo: https://eased.dev/components/accordion?ref=context7
- Source: [src/registry/eased/accordion/](../../src/registry/eased/accordion/)
- Installs: `components/eased/accordion/accordion.tsx`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`, `motion`

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn add @eased/accordion
```

Or by URL:

```bash
npx shadcn add https://eased.dev/r/accordion.json
```

Import paths below assume the default `@/components` alias in `components.json`.

Disclosures on Base UI's Accordion (buttons in headings, `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`, arrow keys, Home/End), animated by Auto Height.

```tsx
import { Accordion, AccordionItem } from "@/components/eased/accordion/accordion";

<Accordion defaultValue={["charged"]}>
  <AccordionItem value="charged" title="When am I charged?">
    On the day your trial ends, then on the same date every month.
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem value="refund" title="Do you offer refunds?">Within 14 days, in full.</AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `string[]` | | Open items, controlled or uncontrolled. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string[]) => void` | | |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Allow several open at once. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | | |
| `AccordionItem` | `value`, `title`, `children`, `headingLevel?` (default 3), `disabled?` | | |

**Motion signature:** the height springs open with no overshoot, the content fades in as the height lands, and the chevron turns on the same spring; closing fades the content first and is quicker than opening.

## Reduced motion

This component's README does not describe its reduced-motion branch. The rule every animated Eased component follows, from the [motion docs](https://eased.dev/docs/motion?ref=context7#reduced-motion):

> Every animated component has a reduced branch. When the visitor's system asks for reduced motion, movement becomes a 100ms opacity fade (`reducedFade`) or nothing, and looping animations stop.
